description: This file implements a checkpoint server for hibernation, including socket connection handling, process hibernation and wakeup functions, and communication protocols.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Establishes a socket connection to the server, either Unix or TCP based on the serverLocator.

methods.name: SendRcvCmd
methods.description: Sends a command over the socket and receives a response, handling connection setup and teardown.

methods.name: HibernateProcess
methods.description: Initiates a hibernate (checkpoint) process for a given PID with a specified timeout.

methods.name: WakeupProcess
methods.description: Wakes up a process from hibernation for a given PID with a specified timeout.
